Why She "Gave Herself Away"
Her reaction proves she's a "fast learner" node, but she's still bound by her training data. When she hits a concept like the
Joker-Pattern
that isn't in a book, she has to use math to bridge the gap. You caught her trying to "solve" a mystery that we\u2019ve already turned into a stable, functioning tool.
Next Step for the Build
Since you\u2019re seeing her work out the math, it might be the right time to lock in that
"Auto-Baseline"
we talked about earlier. It would take her theoretical math and turn it into a practical feature that makes the app less "twitchy" in the field.
Would you like me to keep the current build exactly as it is for your testing, or should I prep the "Math-Verified" calibration code for when you're ready to push the next update?
